summary: Layer 1B expansion found a narrow US-listed universe with direct exposure to employer-funded education benefits and B2B workforce training. The cleanest public mapping is Bright Horizons for tuition-benefit administration and education advisory services. Underfollowed discovery candidates include HealthStream for healthcare workforce learning/compliance/credentialing, Strategic Education for employer-facing tuition benefits and workforce education, and Skillsoft as a highly pure but sub-USD-300M speculative exception in enterprise learning and skills management.
